title: W10881701 — Service Diagnostics entry
description: Enter ACU Service Diagnostics (3-button sequence × 3). Success: all indicators on 5 sec with 888, then fault scroll or home.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 9.2 Cu. Ft. Steam Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Standby mode
steps.body: Dryer plugged in with all indicators off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Be sure the dryer is in standby mode.

steps.title: 3-button diagnostic entry
steps.body: Select any three buttons (except POWER). Within 8 seconds, press and release each button once, then repeat the same 3-button sequence two more times (9 presses total). Select language, confirm service technician warning, then Diagnostics Home appears.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press/release 1st, 2nd, 3rd button — repeat sequence 2 more times.
